Present: Mr. Ritvik Garg, Advocate for the petitioner.
 Mr. Amandeep Singh, Dag, Punjab.
 ****
Sanjay Vashisth, J. (Oral)
1.

Present writ petition has been filed by the petitioner for seeking issuance of writ in the nature of mandamus for directing respondents No. 2 to 5 to protect the life and liberty of the petitioner at the instance of private respondents No. 6 to 8.
2.
On advance notice, Mr. Amandeep Singh, DAG, Punjab, appears and informs the Court that the petitioner was earlier involved in an offence under Section 376 IPC.
Learned State counsel submits that earlier similar petition was filed by the petitioner.

By referring to the order dated 11.09.2024 passed in CRWP-10333-2023 (Annexure P-10), learned State counsel submits that State of Punjab had pointed out to the Court that despite making efforts by summoning the parties, it is the petitioner who never came despite calling repeatedly.
3. At this stage, learned counsel for the petitioner seeks withdrawal of the present petition.
4. Dismissed as withdrawn as prayed for.
